source: local game 1.5.3 GameAssembly.dll native disassembly (BlackHoleMutator.Mutate / onStartedAbility / onStoppedAbility) read-only

activeHoles.meaning: all currently live black-hole GameObjects tracked across casts

extraBlackHoles.meaning: additional black holes spawned per cast (Scattered/Armageddon family)

forceSingleBlackHole.meaning: Singularity: cap black holes per cast to 1 (suppresses extra-hole spawn)

findings.detail: forceSingleBlackHole is only read in BlackHoleMutator.Mutate to gate the extraBlackHoles spawn branch (0x1830827-0x1830841); if extraBlackHoles==0 or forceSingleBlackHole is set, the extra-hole spawn path is skipped. No global count limit or destroy-existing logic exists.

Mutate start (0x182f8cf) removes stale entries from activeHoles (call 0x18085b850 with a match predicate, i.e. RemoveAll-like) and Mutate end (0x1830db5) appends the newly spawned hole GameObject via List<GameObject>.Add@0x1803b0700. onStartedAbility (0x1831fdd) iterates over all active holes to roll blackHoleFireballChanceOnDirect per hole, proving holes from earlier casts remain alive and tracked. No code destroys an existing hole when a new cast starts.
extraBlackHoles>0 (and !forceSingleBlackHole) spawns additional holes for that cast via Ability::getAbility + delayed cast path (0x18308f5-0x1830973).

chanceToRecastOnEnd path (0x1830847-0x18308e2) can spawn another hole at end; this branch is evaluated before/independently of the forceSingleBlackHole gate, so it is a caveat for builds selecting that node (not selected in this build).

conclusion: Multiple casts create independent black holes that coexist and each runs its own duration; Singularity (forceSingleBlackHole) only limits holes created by a single cast to 1 (and suppresses Scattered extra holes), not the global number. This matches user rule 6 and validates v1 eager/patient concurrency modeling (no global cap, overlap allowed).
v1_impact: no numeric change required; upgrade ruleset status from assumption to confirmed for concurrency/per-cast limit. activeHoles is a live-hole registry, not a global cap.
